articles.summary: Greptile ranks #1 on Martian's independent online AI code review benchmark, leading all evaluated tools in F1 score and precision with near-leading recall.
articles.title: Greptile Ranks #1 on Martian's AI Code Review Benchmark

articles.summary: We noticed GPT reviewed Claude's code better than its own, and vice versa. So we ran a thousand buggy PRs through both models to find out why.
articles.title: Models are worse at reviewing their own code

articles.summary: Greptile is more than AI code review. Our goal is to automate code validation end to end: understanding intent, tracing blast radius, running the code, and securing every change.
articles.title: Automating code validation
